data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.subtitle: Lucidworks — San Francisco — Feb 2022 – Jul 2026
bullets: Built features for SaaS platform and on-Prem Fusion UI using StencilJS, TypeScript, and SCSS, delivering a consistent user experience across both deployment models

Shipped and owned AI-powered no-code search UI solutions including configuration screens and result views, enabling drastically faster configuration of solutions for customers and reducing implementation time from a quarter to a week
Supported adoption of Claude Code and Claude Skills across engineering, authoring reusable prompt templates to enable faster AI agent and AI-powered search component development and meet sprint goals
Extended the frontend component library and design system across ten micro-frontend repositories, standardizing reusable components and improving UI consistency, which lowered maintenance effort
Applied deep knowledge of backend data models and defined API contracts with backend engineers, ensuring endpoints met product requirements and reducing post-release integration bugs

Led the Fusion Admin UI roadmap and technical-debt management, applying first-principles thinking to prioritize and resolve a multi-year backlog. Modernized the codebase by upgrading from Webpack 4 to Webpack 5 and node v10 to node v18

Set technical direction for all frontend squads by releasing documentation standards and code quality and PR review guidelines ensuring engineers followed consistent implementation patterns and reduced review cycle time
Hired nearly the entire frontend team over my 12 years at Lucidworks
Collaborated with Product and Design and regularly flagged technical feasibility and edge-case feature gaps in early designs before dev handoff, reducing rework during implementation

data.title: UI Engineer
data.subtitle: Lucidworks — San Francisco — Nov 2017 – Feb 2022
bullets: Transitioned the UI codebase from AngularJS, JavaScript, and SCSS to StencilJS, TypeScript, and SCSS, to implement a web component library that reduced duplicated components across 10 micro frontend repos and 5 squads
Owned the full frontend engineering lifecycle for the Fusion Admin UI, from concept through post-QE feedback, and contributed code to almost every shipped feature, and shipped features on schedule

Built a data-model mapping designer and a custom UI error-logging and observability service using TypeScript and Web Components, providing developers with clear error insights that cut debugging time in customer environments
Implemented SonarQube quality-gate tooling in the frontend pipeline, to set minimum test coverage requirements and catch code smells and security bugs
Assisted other frontend teams with high-priority deliverables by removing technical blockers and making codebases production ready
Helped design and implement the organization’s feature-flag governance model across engineering to enable continuous feature releases on the SaaS platform
Collaborated closely with Product, Design, Backend, and Quality Engineering teams to align feature requirements and testing strategies, resulting in smoother releases and fewer integration issues

data.title: UI Engineer (Contract)
data.subtitle: Lucidworks — Dubai (Remote) — Sep 2014 – Nov 2017
bullets: Developed Fusion Admin UI from v1.2 onwards in Angular 1.2+ along with SCSS

Led development of Query Workbench and Search UI features in Fusion, a real-time pipeline configuration tool that let engineers preview live query changes and compare results with production output, improving debugging efficiency for implementation teams
Implemented UI features for a broad range of Search-domain concepts (datasources, connectors, pipelines, profiles) spanning ingestion, indexing, and querying
Integrated UI features with Fusion and Solr APIs using mocked data stores resulting in quicker delivery times to production
Advanced from following specs to defining and owning frontend integration requirements and architecture decisions
